implementation.allowed_subject: An exact original version-2 reader published-dependency finding outside a nonempty current-run manifest inventory, bound to a manifest-owned consumer that currently reaches the supplier.
implementation.maintenance: Original finding and defect-ledger open/deferred row remain; canonical published ledger retains a literal open maintenance finding.
implementation.sealing: stamp validates receipt then writes decision.context_evidence and hashes a carrier containing supplier raw hash and context seal. check validates receipt, seal and carrier in adjudicate and final phases. check-escalations validates receipt and current seal. Only the specifically bound retained outside defect row is exempt from gate closure.
implementation.decision_owner: Receipt group and decision_path use the actual step5Adjudicators label (batch-15 here); original scope.group remains assignment_group in the context seal. Validator checks current owner artifact identity and exact obligation. Legacy owner only allowed when step5Adjudicators actually selects it.

contexts.finding_sha256: SHA256 canonical sorted-key JSON of the full original scope.reader_findings row (without synthetic batch/route)
contexts.used_clause: nonempty literal current supplier source quote defining exact clause reviewed
premise_quotes: nonempty literal current consumer source quotes supplying missing premises

review.evidence: At least 80 trimmed characters recording the completed mathematical review of the exact clause under these premises.

evidence_refs.path: research/current native Alpha review or root review artifact

maintenance.quote: Literal retained outside maintenance finding, at least 80 trimmed characters.
maintenance.defect_id: exact original open/deferred defect-ledger row with original adjudication_ref

decision_schema.evidence: Honest contextual approval; general published defect remains open.
decision_schema.context_evidence: written by stamp; binds receipt, original finding, supplier/consumer mathematical hashes, review references, retained maintenance quote hash and retained defect-ledger row hash

root_integration: Personally review current supplier/consumer clause and premises; retain published maintenance findings in canonical ledger.
Write the current-run root context receipt using schema above and evidence references to completed actual reviews. Do not edit the original scope/reader report findings.

Change only the two Alpha decisions to context_accepted with exact consumer binding, honest evidence, empty defect_ids and receipt raw hash. Preserve original defect-ledger rows open/deferred and their adjudication_ref.
After all writers drain, stamp affected group batch-15; run root-owned owner-escalation and complete Step5 gates.

verification.reason: Root exclusively owns validation and gates after helper writers drain.

limitations: Validator establishes exact current source/evidence binding; mathematical validity is the root completed review responsibility.

If supplier or consumer mathematical hash, root receipt, review evidence, retained maintenance quote or original defect row changes, context validation/seal fails and root must refresh evidence honestly.
No in-frontier supplier, unresolved used prerequisites or escalated/uncertain review can use this disposition.
owned_code_patch_note: Patch based on HEAD contains only externalContextReceipt/context_accepted code; excludes preexisting activeOwnershipRows, priorAppliedRepair, ownerSharedDefect and published traversal changes.
